name: token-police
description: Chrome (Manifest V3) extension that shows remaining usage for Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Grok Bot and Gemini.

scripts.test: node scripts/parse-test.mjs && node scripts/content-test.mjs && node scripts/update-test.mjs && node scripts/capture-logs-test.mjs && node scripts/popup-card-test.mjs && node scripts/background-test.mjs && node scripts/pages-test.mjs && node scripts/dispatch-test.mjs
scripts.build: web-ext build --source-dir . --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules scripts dist .gitignore docs .github .cursor
scripts.start: web-ext run --source-dir . --target chromium --chromium-binary "$(command -v google-chrome)" --ignore-files package.json package-lock.json node_modules scripts dist .gitignore docs .github .cursor
